chk_media_dimensions_positive.name: chk_media_dimensions_positive

chk_nav_item_shape.name: chk_nav_item_shape
chk_nav_item_shape.value:
(
        "nav_item"."type" = 'link'
        AND "nav_item"."system_key" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "nav_item"."type" = 'system'
        AND "nav_item"."system_key" IS NOT NULL
      )

chk_path_registry_shape.name: chk_path_registry_shape
chk_path_registry_shape.value:
(
        "path_registry"."kind" IN ('slug', 'alias')
        AND (
          ("path_registry"."post_id" IS NOT NULL AND "path_registry"."collection_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("path_registry"."post_id" IS NULL AND "path_registry"."collection_id" IS NOT NULL)
        )
        AND "path_registry"."redirect_to_path" IS NULL
        AND "path_registry"."redirect_type" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "path_registry"."kind" = 'redirect'
        AND "path_registry"."post_id" IS NULL
        AND "path_registry"."collection_id" IS NULL
        AND "path_registry"."redirect_to_path" IS NOT NULL
        AND "path_registry"."redirect_type" IN (301, 302)
      )

idx_post_site_root_live_published_activi.name: idx_post_site_root_live_published_activity
idx_post_site_root_live_published_activi.where: "post"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "post"."reply_to_id" IS NULL AND "post"."status" = 'published'

idx_post_site_root_live_draft_updated.name: idx_post_site_root_live_draft_updated
idx_post_site_root_live_draft_updated.where: "post"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "post"."reply_to_id" IS NULL AND "post"."status" = 'draft'

idx_post_site_reply_live_thread_created.name: idx_post_site_reply_live_thread_created
idx_post_site_reply_live_thread_created.where: "post"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "post"."reply_to_id" IS NOT NULL AND "post"."status" = 'published'

idx_post_site_featured_live_featured_at.name: idx_post_site_featured_live_featured_at
idx_post_site_featured_live_featured_at.where: "post"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "post"."status" = 'published' AND "post"."featured_at" IS NOT NULL

chk_post_thread_shape.name: chk_post_thread_shape
chk_post_thread_shape.value:
(
        "post"."reply_to_id" IS NULL
        AND "post"."thread_id" = "post"."id"
      ) OR (
        "post"."reply_to_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "post"."thread_id" <> "post"."id"
      )
